_comment: Smart routing uses Claude to classify sound bytes against project descriptions. Prefix routes and default_route are fallbacks only.

smart_routes.description: Project 1 — describe what kinds of interviews belong here (e.g. product features, AI workflows, internal tooling)
Project 2 — describe what kinds of interviews belong here (e.g. data, analytics, reporting features)
Project 3 — describe what kinds of interviews belong here (e.g. operations, logistics, planning)

default_route.description: Default fallback — use when no project is a clear fit

_voice_memos_icloud_path_note: To use the native iCloud sync path instead, grant Full Disk Access to Terminal in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Full Disk Access, then change to: ~/Library/Group Containers/group.com.apple.VoiceMemos.shared/Recordings/
